prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, each from a different look, each with her own multi-material blended body.

#1: THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, early 50s silver fox goddess, curvy petite physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — smallest most compact frame possible yet curves exploding at absolute maximum in every direction, bubble butt projecting dramatically backward from the tiny frame, thighs so thick they dwarf the petite frame, silver-white hair in a low bun — her body carries 4 different materials at once, each claiming its own region of her figure. A long hazy transition zone runs diagonally from the upper left edge of her figure to the lower right edge, as seen by the camera. A second transition zone branches off it about 60% of the way along its length and runs to the upper right edge. A third transition zone branches off it about 80% of the way along its length and runs to the lower left edge. Together the three zones divide her figure into 4 large irregular pieces. Region 1 is the piece above the long diagonal and before the second branch (the upper left): it carries traditional irezumi tattoo ink, bold black ink outlines, dragon phoenix formations in ELECTRIC GOLD and CRIMSON, extreme high-gloss oil finish. Region 2 is the piece above the long diagonal and beyond the second branch (the upper right): it carries pale golden oak wood fused directly into her own form, natural straight grain lines flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING warm honey-blonde grain with VIVID amber highlight streaks. Region 3 is the piece below the long diagonal and before the third branch (the lower left): it carries dragon scales (large thick armor-plate scales, each one substantial and sharply faceted), BLAZING GLOSSY JET BLACK scale formations, VIVID DEEP PURPLE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 4 is the piece below the long diagonal and beyond the third branch (the lower right): it carries UV-reactive neon bodypaint, invisible under standard light but DNA helix formations in ELECTRIC MAGENTA and CYAN glowing at full intensity under her own dedicated UV blacklight. Where two regions meet, the materials interlock naturally: elements of one reach into the other and the two materials simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring materials, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating course, rippling softly rather than staying perfectly regular, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: strong hip pop left, both hands pressing outer hips outward arching back to extreme, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme curvy petite silhouette ever displayed. A standard hard key light illuminates most of her body; a separate dedicated UV blacklight illuminates the UV-reactive region specifically, making it glow at full intensity while the rest reads under normal light.
#1: extreme platform heels/boots blending the relevant materials at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever region that hand falls in.

#2: THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, early 40s silver fox goddess, powerlifter bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — immense powerful thighs and shoulders built with real strength, a thick solid waist, overwhelming muscular bulk layered with soft curves everywhere, silver-white sleek wet-look hair slicked straight back — her body carries 3 different materials at once, each claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is covered mainly by one background material, with 2 large round patches of other materials scattered irregularly across it, each patch roughly 21% of her figure's width across. Region 1 is the background: everything outside the round patches: it carries applied ROSE-GOLD leaf, thin irregular metallic sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, VIVID CYAN undertone glinting through the thinnest points. Region 2 is the round patch centred about 30% of the way down her figure from the top and about 80% of the way across her figure from her left edge: it carries koi scales (rounded smooth scales with fine visible growth rings, each scale glossy and slightly domed), BLAZING METALLIC GOLD scale formations, VIVID PLATINUM scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 3 is the round patch centred about 34% of the way down her figure from the top and about 27% of the way across her figure from her left edge: it carries peacock feather-eye markings (overlapping feather-barb ridges each converging into a round eye-marking with a raised rim), BLAZING ELECTRIC TEAL eye-marking centres, VIVID GOLD radiating barb-ridge detail, every marking standing in true relief. Where a patch meets the background, the two materials interlock naturally: elements of one reach into the other and the two materials simply touch, so the edge of every patch is made only of the patch's material and the background material, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each patch edge follows a gently rippled outline rather than a perfect circle, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: strong hip pop right, both hands pressing sides of hips outward simultaneously arching back to extreme, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme powerlifter bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
#2: extreme platform heels/boots blending the relevant materials at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever region that hand falls in.

Environment: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient.
All: Extreme macro detail on every material and every blended transition, realistic photographic grain on the realistic-skin and pregnant women, extreme high-gloss oil on the darkest-skin women. CRITICAL: all 2 women's legs must show FULL BODY ART coverage from hip to ankle to toe with NO bare untattooed skin visible anywhere. TWO completely different extreme physiques must CONTRAST and DOMINATE every inch of frame. 8K portrait 3:4 aspect ratio.
